fusions.name: Pounce Across the Gap
fusions.desc: Looses an arm across the gap that deals 8 damage, rising to 2 times that at the full 7 tiles. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Landing Pin
fusions.desc: Rushes you up to 6 tiles to the first enemy in your path and slams an arm into it, dealing 14 damage.

fusions.name: Sprung Elsewhere
fusions.desc: Steps you instantly to a point up to 7 tiles away. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Hop and Try Again
fusions.desc: Once every 8 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
